For wind, rain and risk, the system gives more weight to the point showing the less favourable signal so local warnings are not smoothed away. Wind at coastal points may be adjusted for exposure and local shelter before probability is calculated. The variability score /100 reflects spread between models, while the confidence score /100 reflects the quality of available information - neither is the probability that the forecast will be correct. The first three days use 6-hour steps; days 4-10 use 12-hour steps with gradually lower confidence.

about.Lên lịch đi Phú Quốc cực nhất là phải nh: Planning Phu Quoc is hardest when you have to piece together information from a dozen different places. Open Phu Quoc brings practical weather, transport and local travel context into one place so you can make decisions with less guesswork.
about.Được xây dựng và chăm sóc tại đảo bởi Jo: Built and maintained on the island by JoTrip.
about.Cảng cá An Thới và nhịp sống phía Nam đả: An Thoi fishing port and life in the south of the island, April 2026.
about.Giữa ma trận thông tin rối rắm, bạn cần: Travel information gets messy quickly. We try to make the useful parts easier to understand and act on.
about.Biết tên một cái bãi, một hòn đảo chỉ mớ: Knowing the name of a beach or island is only the first step. What travellers really need is what to do there, how long it takes, when to go and what fits naturally on the same route.
about.Đặc sản của đảo là thời tiết biển, giờ t: Sea weather, ferries and speedboat operations can change quickly. That is why fast-moving information is timestamped and kept separate from slower-changing guide content.
about.Nói rõ khi chưa chắc: Say when we are not sure
about.Dự báo thì vẫn mãi là dự báo, và thấy tà: A forecast is still a forecast, and a scheduled ferry does not mean seats are available. If something is confirmed, we say so. If it is uncertain or changes by day, we make that uncertainty visible.
about.Ba bộ lọc thông tin thực chiến cứu nguy: Three practical layers help you make a better travel decision.
about.Điểm check-in, quán ngon, chỗ ngủ hay vă: Places, food, accommodation and local culture are edited for useful detail rather than generic praise.
about.Những thứ thay đổi theo giờ: Information that changes by the hour
about.Bảng tin thời tiết, biến động chuyến bay: Weather, flight changes and ferry information follow the update rhythm of each source and show timestamps so you can judge how current the information is.
about.Để bạn tự quyết định: So you can make your own decision
about.Open Phu Quoc trả mọi điểm đến về đúng t: Open Phu Quoc tries to show places as they are. Whether something is beautiful or worth it is personal; our job is to make the facts and trade-offs clear enough for you to decide.
about.Jotrip xây nền tảng này cho những ai muố: JoTrip built this platform for travellers who want a more local understanding of the island.
about.Viết để bạn có thêm cơ sở chọn lịch trìn: We write to help you choose, not to make every place sound like an advertisement.

about.Open Phu Quoc nhận góp ý để sửa những th: Open Phu Quoc accepts feedback to correct inaccurate information, add missing places and improve the guide, including feedback on machine-assisted translations. You do not need an account.
about.Nội dung góp ý, mã và tên địa điểm hoặc: The system may store the feedback text, place or article ID and name, issue type, translation language, selected passage, proposed correction, content version when available, page URL, submission time and any image you choose to attach. The form does not require your name, email address or GPS permission. To reduce abuse, the server uses a daily rotating control token derived from connection information and a secret key; the feedback table does not store the original IP address.
about.Ai xem được và thông tin dùng để làm gì?: Who can see it and what is it used for?
about.Chỉ người có quyền truy cập CMS mới xem: Only people with CMS access can review feedback and attachments. Feedback is a suggestion that must be checked; it does not automatically publish content, move a map pin or replace an official operating confirmation. Feedback images are not made public on the website.
about.Nếu biên tập viên xác nhận một cách diễn: If an editor confirms a better phrasing, the approved passage and correction may be retained in the terminology memory to improve later translations. This memory does not store the contributor's name, email, IP address or personal profile. An approved correction does not automatically change already published content. You can use your reference code to request review or withdrawal of a contribution.
about.Nếu tính năng gửi ảnh được bật, ảnh được: If image upload is enabled, images are stored in a separate private store and do not have a public URL. Phone photos may contain location metadata or personal details. Send only images that are necessary and avoid faces, documents or private information. Original feedback records and images are deleted after a maximum of 180 days through a daily cleanup process; failed cleanup attempts are retried.
about.Sau khi gửi thành công, hãy lưu mã tham: After a successful submission, keep the reference code. You can send a deletion request with that code to
